posts.title: I Am Not a Functional Programmer
posts.description: Despite rumors to the contrary, I am not actually a functional programmer. True, I sometimes slip and fall and an "applicative functor" would come out from under my breath. But surely you shouldn't…

posts.title: The Compiler Is Your Best Friend, Stop Lying to It
posts.description: The compiler is a powerful tool, yet many developers have a painful relationship with it. Can we do better?

posts.title: What's the Point of Learning Functional Programming?
posts.description: "What's the point of learning functional programming?" was a genuine question I got from a student on a functional programming course I was TAing on.
